retrievalProfile.description: A vertical split-field layout featuring high-contrast monochrome photography in framed boxes against a dual-tone cyan and orange background with heavy sans-serif display type.
triggerTerms: split color background with framed photos

recipe.visualDefinition: A graphic composition divided vertically into two distinct color fields, containing three rectangular framed monochrome photographs and a left-aligned typographic block using heavy, condensed sans-serif fonts.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical bisecting line separating cyan and orange fields
Asymmetrical balance between large text on the left and stacked photos on the right
High-contrast black and white photography within thin black borders
Consistent horizontal alignment between text blocks and photo frames

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three monochrome photos of varying sizes; one large top-right, one medium bottom-right, and one medium bottom-center overlapping the split.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, bold display title in the upper-left quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-left title, moves down through the tracklist, then jumps to the right-hand photo sequence.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Tight margins with dense information blocks; negative space is defined by the flat color fields.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cyan blue (left field) and muted orange (right field).
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black and white for photography and text outlines.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Cream or off-white for primary display text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Muted, mid-tone saturation with a vintage paper texture overlay.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to two primary background hues plus black and white.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Hyphens and dots used as geometric separators in tracklists
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Varying weights and scales of the same condensed sans-serif family.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, flat-terminal look of the main title.
Provides the necessary mid-century editorial feel for secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a vertical split background with cyan on the left and orange on the right. Place three monochrome, high-contrast photos in thin black frames: one large in the top right, one medium in the bottom right, and one medium in the bottom center overlapping the split line. Apply a subtle paper grain texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, condensed sans-serif text in all-caps. The main title should be large and cream-colored in the top left. Secondary tracklist text should be smaller and black in the bottom left, separated by a thin horizontal line.

verificationChecks: Is the background split vertically into two colors?
Are the photos monochrome and framed?
Is the typography bold, condensed, and all-caps?
Is the layout left-aligned for text?

mustRedesign: Specific artist names and album titles
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is condensed and all-caps
Confirm presence of thin black frames around photos
recipe.reuseFormula: Split-field color block + framed monochrome photography + condensed sans-serif display type.
